source_class_fields: private static final Predicate<Node> SIDE_EFFECT_PREDICATE = new Predicate<Node>() { @Override public boolean apply(Node n) { // When the node is null it means, we reached the implicit return // where the function returns (possibly without an return statement) if (n == null) { return false; } // TODO(user): We only care about calls to functions that // passes one of the dependent variable to a non-side-effect free // function. if (n.isCall() && NodeUtil.functionCallHasSideEffects(n)) { return true; } if (n.isNew() && NodeUtil.constructorCallHasSideEffects(n)) { return true; } if (n.isDelProp()) { return true; } for (Node c = n.getFirstChild(); c != null; c = c.getNext()) { if (!ControlFlowGraph.isEnteringNewCfgNode(c) && apply(c)) { return true; } } return false; } };
